name: go-ytm
description: A terminal-based YouTube Music player with offline playback and high-resolution Kitty graphics. Built using a hybrid architecture with a Go TUI and Python sidecar.
features: Designed a feature-rich, terminal-based YouTube Music player utilizing a complex hybrid architecture.
Built an ultra-fast Go TUI (Terminal User Interface) with Vim-like keybindings, communicating with an isolated Python sidecar for robust YouTube API extraction.
Engineered offline caching systems and native Kitty terminal integrations to render high-resolution album art entirely within the terminal.
